summary_text: Machine learning is to make predictions about future outcomes like will the stock go up or which YouTube video do you want to watch next . The first step in the process is to acquire and clean up data lots and lots of data . Data scientists perform a job called feature engineering to transform raw data into features that better represent the underlying problem . The next step is to separate the data into a training set and testing set . Training data is fed into an algorithm to build a model then the testing data is used to validate the accuracy or error of the model . When the new data point comes in it can easily predict for it more the data better the model higher will be the accuracy .
